text:
devon: FYI Parker Health asking for a pricing plan where Dedicated gets an account-level burst buffer + per-endpoint throttles.
sanjay: can we do account burst + per-endpoint caps? sounds like dual control which is extra stateful.
liz: finance prefers deterministic add-ons (e.g., "priority-burst-pack") instead of unlimited soft promises. we can offer a limited trial bridge.
anya: typo — I meant @anya; anya: replied: trial bridge OK, but we need explicit launch gates: cap, audit, downgrade behavior. no unlimited promises in contract.
sanjay: technical note: dual cap design = account_burst_pool + endpoint_reserved_share. will add ~1 sprint for accounting + 1 for enforcement hooks.
devon: customer insists on per-endpoint granularity for one heavy ingestion route only. could we ship account-wide GA, per-endpoint in pilot?
liz: sounds reasonable. Pilot terms: 90d trial, $25k trial cap, overage billing post-trial at negotiated rate. legal wants clause: "trial credits are not a guarantee of continued capacity".
pricing-bot: quick sketch: ```
plan: Dedicated Pro
base_tokens/mo: 500M
burst_pack: monthly addon
account_pool: 3x baseline for 4 hours/day
endpoint_override: pilot-only, one endpoint
trial: 90d, $25,000 cap
fallback: degraded model variant or queued processing
billing: per-burst event + monthly reconciliation
```
anya: launch acceptance criteria proposal: 1) perf sims show <200ms p95 during 3x bursts for 30m on staging; 2) billing emits burst events with JSON schema; 3) console exposes toggle + visible estimated cost; 4) legal sign-off on trial clause.
sanjay: runtime caveat: degraded model path will change output length and latency; we need a short prompt-preservation shim if customers care about semantic fidelity. estimate +2 weeks.
devon: sales ask: can we include a free onramp where we waive first-month overages? liz: maybe if they sign a 12mo commit and commit to a minimum spend.
anya: action items: @sanjay produce implementation estimate and failure modes, @liz draft pilot commercial terms with cap + 12mo upsell path, @devon get Parker to agree to pilot metrics + commit window, I'll author the PRD and acceptance checklist.
pricing-bot: PRD draft created: https://redwood/internal/prd/burst-pack-pilot-1712223334 (draft).
devon: I'll schedule a 30m sync with Parker and legal. meeting invite incoming.
anya: thanks all — quick standup tomorrow to review sanjay's estimate.
pricing-bot: Note: thread archived and checklist task /tasks/1712223334 created.
